# sophosfirewall_gateway (Resource)

Manages a custom IPv4 gateway (*Configure > Routing > Gateways*). Gateways are referenced by name from SD-WAN routes and SD-WAN profiles. The gateways the firewall creates for WAN interfaces cannot be managed with this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Custom gateway with a ping and a TCP health check.
resource "sophosfirewall_gateway" "mpls" {
  name       = "mpls-primary"
  ip_address = "192.0.2.1"
  interface  = "Port3"
  zone       = "WAN"

  health_check = {
    enabled  = true
    interval = 30
    timeout  = 2
    retries  = 3
    rules = [
      { protocol = "ping", host = "192.0.2.254" },
      { protocol = "tcp", host = "192.0.2.253", port = 443, logical_operator = "and" },
    ]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip_address` (String) IPv4 address of the gateway.
- `name` (String) Unique name of the gateway. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `health_check` (Attributes) Gateway health check. A gateway that fails its health check is taken out of SD-WAN routing. Omit to turn health checking off. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--health_check))
- `interface` (String) Name of the interface through which the gateway is reached.
- `zone` (String) Name of the zone of the gateway.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the object assigned by the firewall.

<a id="nestedatt--health_check"></a>
### Nested Schema for `health_check`

Required:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether health check monitoring is turned on.

Optional:

- `interval` (Number) Time in seconds between checks (5-65535). Defaults to the firewall's setting.
- `retries` (Number) Failed checks before the gateway is considered unreachable (1-10). Defaults to the firewall's setting.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Monitoring conditions (1-8), evaluated in order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--health_check--rules))
- `timeout` (Number) Time in seconds to wait for a response (1-10). Defaults to the firewall's setting.

<a id="nestedatt--health_check--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `health_check.rules`

Required:

- `host` (String) IPv4 address to probe.
- `protocol` (String) Probe protocol. One of `ping`, `tcp`.

Optional:

- `logical_operator` (String) How this condition combines with the previous ones. One of `and`, `or`. Defaults to `and`.
- `port` (Number) TCP port to probe. Not applicable to `ping`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by name or UUID.
terraform import sophosfirewall_gateway.example <name-or-uuid>
```
